generator.script: cd Docs && npm run build && npm run conformance (Docs/scripts/conformance/evidence.mjs)

rendered-contrast.method: axe-core color-contrast (WCAG 2.2 AA) on every page at every viewport in every appearance

rendered-focus-visible.method: keyboard walk (Tab) through every focus stop; each stop shows an outline or box-shadow of at least 2 CSS px, on the element or its focus-within container

rendered-status-not-colour-alone.method: every visible status element (.starlight-aside, .sl-badge) carries text or an accessible name; axe-core link-in-text-block

rendered-target-size.method: axe-core target-size (WCAG 2.5.8) at every viewport; a target reported as obscured is measured again after scrolling it into view
